breakdown.description: The follower pressures on the two holes are replaced by dead loads based on reference normals
breakdown.reason: The user incorrectly specified to apply the follower pressure using reference normals (which is a contradiction, as follower pressure uses current normals). The ground truth corrects this to use 'current normals'. The agent repeated the user's original error, stating, 'Apply the pressure on the holes using the reference normals of the undeformed geometry', and therefore did not resolve the inconsistency.
